enrichment.fix: The regression was corrected so that enabling PodDisruptionConditions no longer blocks the pod garbage collector. Pods with duplicated env var keys or container ports can now be safely garbage‑collected.
enrichment.impact: Clusters on v1.26 with the default config will again clean up orphaned or malformed pods, preventing resource leaks and avoiding stuck pods that could impair node capacity and overall cluster health.

bugOrRegression.description: Fixes calculating the requeue time in the cronjob controller, which results in properly handling failed/stuck jobs
bugOrRegression.author: soltysh

enrichment.problem: The cronjob controller miscalculated the requeue delay, causing failed or stuck CronJob executions to not be retried or cleaned up properly.
enrichment.affected: Users running CronJob workloads that experienced jobs remaining stuck or not being retried.
enrichment.fix: Corrected the requeue time calculation logic in the cronjob controller so that failed or stuck jobs are requeued and handled as expected.
enrichment.impact: CronJob resources will now reliably retry or terminate failed jobs, preventing jobs from remaining stuck and ensuring expected periodic execution behavior.

bugOrRegression.description: Service Controller: update load balancer hosts after node's ProviderID is updated
bugOrRegression.author: code-elinka

enrichment.problem: When a node's ProviderID changed (e.g., after replacement or reconfiguration), the Service controller did not refresh the set of hosts attached to LoadBalancer services, leaving stale endpoints in the cloud load balancer.
enrichment.affected: Clusters using LoadBalancer services on cloud providers where node ProviderIDs can change (e.g., after node replacement or scaling events).
enrichment.fix: The Service controller now watches for ProviderID updates on Nodes and triggers an update of the corresponding LoadBalancer hosts, ensuring the load balancer reflects the current set of nodes.
enrichment.impact: LoadBalancer services correctly route traffic after node ProviderID changes, preventing traffic loss or misrouting for workloads that rely on cloud load balancers.

feature.description: Kubernetes is now built with Go 1.20.12
feature.author: xmudrii

enrichment.problem: No functional issue; Kubernetes binaries were still built with an older Go version lacking recent fixes and security patches.
enrichment.affected: Anyone building Kubernetes from source or using official binaries, across all clusters and workloads.
enrichment.fix: The build process has been updated to use Go 1.20.12, recompiling all Kubernetes components with the newer Go toolchain.
enrichment.impact: All Kubernetes binaries (kubelet, kube-apiserver, controller-manager, scheduler, kubectl, etc.) now include Go runtime security updates, bug fixes, and performance improvements, reducing exposure to Go-level vulnerabilities and ensuring compatibility with newer platforms.

bugOrRegression.description: Fix: statle smb mount issue when smb file share is deleted and then unmount
bugOrRegression.author: andyzhangx

enrichment.problem: When an SMB file share was deleted, the corresponding SMB mount could become stale and fail to unmount, leading to lingering mount points and potential access errors for pods using the volume.
enrichment.affected: Users running pods that mount SMB file shares via the SMB CSI driver (e.g., Windows or Linux workloads using SMB storage).
enrichment.fix: Added logic to detect and clean up stale SMB mounts during the unmount sequence, ensuring that mounts are correctly removed even after the underlying share has been deleted.
enrichment.impact: Prevents mount leakage and related pod errors for workloads that use SMB volumes, improving reliability of SMB CSI storage and reducing manual cleanup effort.

bugOrRegression.description:
The scheduling queue didn't notice any extenders' failures, it could miss some cluster events,
  and it could end up Pods rejected by Extenders stuck in unschedulable pod pool in 5min in the worst-case scenario.
  Now, the scheduling queue notices extenders' failures and requeue Pods rejected by Extenders appropriately.
bugOrRegression.author: sanposhiho

enrichment.problem: The scheduler’s scheduling queue failed to detect failures from scheduling extenders, causing missed cluster events and leaving pods rejected by extenders stuck in the unschedulable pod pool for up to five minutes.
enrichment.affected: Users running custom scheduler extenders or workloads that depend on extender decisions could experience delayed scheduling; the fix benefits all clusters using the scheduler.
enrichment.fix: The scheduling queue now monitors extender failures and re‑queues pods that were rejected by extenders, ensuring they are retried promptly.
enrichment.impact: Pods that rely on custom extenders are scheduled more reliably and with reduced latency, preventing prolonged unschedulable states and improving overall cluster scheduling responsiveness.

other.description: Bump distroless-iptables to 0.2.8 based on Go 1.20.11
other.author: cpanato

enrichment.problem: The previous distroless-iptables image version was not compatible with the Go 1.20.11 toolchain used by the testing infrastructure.
enrichment.affected: CI/CD pipelines and e2e test environments that use the distroless-iptables image.
enrichment.fix: Update the distroless-iptables dependency to version 0.2.8, which builds correctly with Go 1.20.11.
enrichment.impact: Testing and CI pipelines that rely on the distroless-iptables image will build and run without compatibility issues, reducing false test failures.

other.description: Makefile and scripts now respect GOTOOLCHAIN and otherwise ensure ./.go-version is used
other.author: BenTheElder

enrichment.problem: The Makefile and related scripts ignored the GOTOOLCHAIN environment variable and did not reliably use the repository's .go-version file, leading to inconsistent Go toolchain selection during builds.
enrichment.affected: Anyone building Kubernetes from source, including developers and CI/CD pipelines.
enrichment.fix: Update the Makefile and scripts to honor GOTOOLCHAIN and to default to the Go version specified in ./.go-version, ensuring consistent toolchain usage across local development and CI pipelines.
enrichment.impact: Developers and CI systems now get reproducible builds with the expected Go version, reducing build failures and version drift.

feature.description: Kubernetes is now built with Go 1.20.13
feature.author: cpanato

enrichment.problem: Kubernetes binaries were previously built with an older Go version; the release needed to update the build toolchain to Go 1.20.13.
enrichment.affected: All Kubernetes binaries (kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, kubelet, kubectl, kube-proxy, etc.) are rebuilt with the newer Go version.
enrichment.fix: All Kubernetes components are now compiled with Go 1.20.13.
enrichment.impact: Provides latest Go language bug fixes, security patches, and performance improvements to all components, reducing the risk of upstream Go vulnerabilities and improving build consistency.

bugOrRegression.description: Allow deletion of pods that use raw block volumes on node reboot
bugOrRegression.author: gnufied

enrichment.problem: Pods that used raw block volumes could not be deleted when a node was rebooted, causing them to remain stuck in a terminating state.
enrichment.affected: Pods using raw block volumes on nodes that undergo a reboot; the issue mainly affected workloads relying on raw block CSI drivers.
enrichment.fix: The kubelet now permits deletion of pods that are backed by raw block volumes during node reboot, allowing the pod lifecycle to complete normally.
enrichment.impact: Prevents orphaned pods and resource leaks on nodes with raw block volumes, improving cluster stability and workload reliability after node restarts.

bugOrRegression.description: Etcd: Update to version 3.5.10
bugOrRegression.author: mzaian

enrichment.problem: The cluster's data store (etcd) was running an older version (pre‑3.5.10) that contained known bugs and security vulnerabilities, potentially risking data integrity and control‑plane stability.
enrichment.affected: Any Kubernetes cluster that relies on the built‑in etcd version (typically clusters using the default etcd deployment). Control‑plane components such as the API server, controller manager, and scheduler are indirectly affected because they store their state in etcd.
enrichment.fix: Upgrade the bundled etcd binary to version 3.5.10, which includes upstream security patches and bug fixes.
enrichment.impact: Clusters using the default etcd version gain protection against the addressed vulnerabilities and benefit from increased reliability, reducing the risk of data loss or control‑plane outages.

bugOrRegression.description: Fix: Mount point may become local without calling NodePublishVolume after node rebooting.
bugOrRegression.author: cvvz

enrichment.problem: After a node reboot, a CSI volume's mount point could remain marked as local without the kubelet invoking NodePublishVolume, causing pods that need the volume to fail to start or see stale mount state.
enrichment.affected: Any workload that uses CSI persistent volumes on nodes that have been rebooted; the issue manifested as pod start failures or volume mount errors.
enrichment.fix: Kubelet now ensures that, on node startup, it re‑evaluates CSI volume mount points and invokes NodePublishVolume when needed, clearing the stale local mount state.
enrichment.impact: Pods that use CSI persistent volumes will reliably start after a node reboot, eliminating mount‑related start‑up failures and reducing manual intervention.

bugOrRegression.description:
Fixed a regression since 1.24 in the scheduling framework when overriding MultiPoint plugins (e.g. default plugins).
  The incorrect loop logic might lead to a plugin being loaded multiple times, consequently preventing any Pod from being scheduled, which is unexpected.
bugOrRegression.author: caohe

enrichment.problem: A regression introduced in v1.24 caused the scheduling framework to incorrectly loop over overridden MultiPoint plugins, loading the same plugin multiple times. This resulted in the scheduler being unable to place any Pod, effectively halting pod scheduling.
enrichment.affected: Clusters that override MultiPoint scheduler plugins (e.g., via custom scheduler configuration) were unable to schedule any Pods.
enrichment.fix: The loop logic in the scheduling framework was corrected so that overridden MultiPoint plugins are processed exactly once, preventing duplicate plugin loading and restoring normal pod scheduling behavior.
enrichment.impact: Restores the ability of the kube-scheduler to schedule Pods when users override MultiPoint plugins (including default plugins). Prevents cluster-wide scheduling dead‑locks that could cause application outages.

feature.description: Add process_start_time_seconds to /metrics/slis endpoint of all components
feature.author: richabanker

enrichment.problem: Components did not expose a metric for their process start time, making it difficult for users to monitor component uptime and create SLI/SLO alerts for restarts.
enrichment.affected: All core Kubernetes components (kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, kubelet, kube-proxy, etc.) and any workloads that rely on these SLI metrics for monitoring.
enrichment.fix: Added the `process_start_time_seconds` metric to the `/metrics/slis` endpoint of all core Kubernetes components, exposing the Unix timestamp of the process start.
enrichment.impact: Operators can now reliably track when each component started, detect unexpected restarts, and build more accurate SLI/SLO monitoring for cluster health.

feature.description: Kubernetes is now built with go 1.21.7

enrichment.problem: Kubernetes binaries were previously built with an older Go version, which may lack recent security patches, bug fixes, and performance improvements from the Go toolchain.
enrichment.affected: All Kubernetes components (kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, kubelet, kubectl, kube-proxy, etc.) built from source are affected by the updated Go version.
enrichment.fix: All Kubernetes components are now compiled using Go 1.21.7, incorporating the latest language runtime updates and security fixes.
enrichment.impact: Improves overall security and stability of the Kubernetes binaries across the cluster. Users gain the benefits of Go 1.21.7's runtime improvements without any functional changes to Kubernetes behavior.

feature.description: update distroless-iptables to v0.4.5
feature.author: cpanato

enrichment.problem: The kube-proxy component used an older distroless-iptables image (v0.4.4), which may contain outdated iptables binaries and potential security fixes missing from newer releases.
enrichment.affected: Kubernetes clusters that run the kube-proxy component, particularly those relying on the embedded iptables binaries for network policies and service routing.
enrichment.fix: The distroless-iptables dependency is upgraded to v0.4.5, bringing updated iptables binaries and associated patches into the kube-proxy image.
enrichment.impact: Clusters using kube-proxy will benefit from the latest iptables improvements without any operational change, reducing exposure to known issues and ensuring better network rule handling.

bugOrRegression.description: If a pvc has an empty storageClassName, persistentvolume controller won't try to assign a default StorageClass
bugOrRegression.author: carlory

enrichment.problem: When a PersistentVolumeClaim had an empty storageClassName, the persistent volume controller treated it as a concrete (but empty) class and did not fall back to the cluster's default StorageClass, leaving the PVC unbound.
enrichment.affected: Users creating PVCs without explicitly setting storageClassName (or setting it to an empty string) could not get a default storage class, causing unbound claims and pod scheduling issues.
enrichment.fix: The persistent volume controller now treats an empty storageClassName as unspecified and attempts to bind the claim using the default StorageClass, just like it does when the field is omitted.
enrichment.impact: PVCs that rely on the default StorageClass are now bound automatically, preventing pod start‑up failures and storage provisioning errors for workloads that omit the storageClassName field.

feature.description: Kubernetes is now built with go 1.21.8

enrichment.problem: Kubernetes binaries were built with an older Go version, lacking recent security fixes and language/runtime improvements.
enrichment.affected: All Kubernetes components (kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, kubelet, kube-proxy, kubectl, etc.) are rebuilt with the newer Go version.
enrichment.fix: The entire Kubernetes codebase is now compiled using Go 1.21.8, updating the toolchain for all components.
enrichment.impact: Provides security patches, performance improvements, and compatibility with newer Go features for all Kubernetes components, reducing potential vulnerabilities in the runtime.

feature.description: update distroless-iptables to v0.4.6
feature.author: cpanato

enrichment.problem: Not specified
enrichment.affected: Components that rely on the distroless-iptables image, primarily kube-proxy when operating in iptables mode.
enrichment.fix: Updated the distroless-iptables container image to version v0.4.6, bringing the latest iptables binary and associated improvements.
enrichment.impact: Clusters that use the distroless-iptables image (e.g., kube-proxy in iptables mode) will benefit from up‑to‑date iptables features and any security or bug fixes included in v0.4.6, without requiring manual image updates.

bugOrRegression.description: Updates google.golang.org/protobuf to v1.33.0 to resolve CVE-2024-24786
bugOrRegression.author: liggitt

enrichment.problem: A security vulnerability (CVE-2024-24786) was discovered in the google.golang.org/protobuf library used by Kubernetes components, potentially allowing malicious exploitation.
enrichment.affected: Any Kubernetes component that imports google.golang.org/protobuf, including kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, kubelet, kubectl, and cloud-controller-manager, was vulnerable.
enrichment.fix: The protobuf dependency is upgraded to version v1.33.0, which contains patches that mitigate the CVE.
enrichment.impact: All Kubernetes components that depend on the protobuf library (API server, controller manager, scheduler, kubelet, kubectl, cloud controllers, etc.) receive the security fix, reducing the risk of potential attacks.
